title: Global UI localization & keyboard traversal sweep for Console dashboards, rollouts, and cost views
creator: Maya Chen
description: Scope: Run a cross-surface accessibility and internationalization sweep focused on Console dashboards, rollout management UI, and the cost view. Goals: 1) Ensure full keyboard traversal and predictable focus order across dashboard cards, rollout toggles, and cost filters; 2) Meet WCAG AA contrast targets for key interactive controls across light/dark themes; 3) Verify locale-sensitive formatting (numbers, percentages, currencies) and support for RTL languages where layout impacts components; 4) Produce a small high-fidelity prototype and annotated spec for engineering. Acceptance criteria: keyboard-only flows for primary tasks (open rollout, change rollout percent, apply cost filter, export CSV) complete without mouse; automated color-contrast tests pass for interactive elements; localized strings fit without truncation for all supported locales and RTL toggles do not break alignment or animation timing.
notes:
2026-02-26: Kickoff meeting with PM and Eng. Agreed to scope dashboard list, rollout detail modal, and cost view filter bar as the first pass.
2026-03-01: Initial audit completed against current Console: found inconsistent focus rings on table rows, non-semantic 'div' buttons used in rollout timeline, cost card sparkline uses purely decorative color with contrast < 3:1 in dark mode.
2026-03-03: Prototype created in Figma for keyboard focus styles and compact cost rows (see artifacts).
2026-03-05: Accessibility engineer review (Riley Park) flagged potential reflow issues in Arabic (ar) for the filters dropdown; recommended testing with long-number formats and +/- sign positions.
2026-03-08: Engineering feasibility sync: Luca confirmed small DOM changes acceptable, but rollout timeline animation needs a debounce to avoid focus loss during transition.
2026-03-10: Preparing PRs and spec handoff; currently in design review with updated tokens and accessibility notes. Next: add automated e2e keyboard tests and CI color-contrast checks.
accessibility_checks: Keyboard focus order for cards, modals, dropdowns, and inline editable fields
Add ARIA labels to non-semantic interactive elements and ensure role correctness
Visible focus ring with 3px contrast delta from background at all sizes
Color contrast for primary/secondary buttons and status badges to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 (normal text) and 3:1 for large text
Test with screen readers (NVDA/VoiceOver) for rollout modal and table sorting controls
Skip links and consistent landmarks for dashboard landing
localization_checks: Locale-aware number and currency formatting (en-US, fr-FR, de-DE, ja-JP, ar) including thousands separator and decimal styles
Percent formatting and rounding parity with backend reporting
String length accommodation: buttons, tooltips, and error messages - ensure no truncation at +40% length
RTL layout validation: mirrored icons, padding, and animation direction for rollout timeline
Use ICU placeholders for pluralization in cost summaries
design_decisions: Introduce a system focus token (outline-2) with accessible color pairings for light/dark themes
Replace non-semantic div-buttons in rollout timeline with <button> and explicit aria-pressed attributes
Move currency/unit formatting to a display helper layer to keep UI markup locale-agnostic
Compress dashboard card spacing for keyboard traversal while keeping 48px touch targets for mobile
Keep current animation easing but add a 80ms focus-safe debounce during rollout percentage changes
review_feedback:
2026-03-06 (Riley Park): 'Focus ring visibility still poor on dark theme when adjacent element uses gradient. Suggest use of overlay ring token.'
2026-03-07 (Diego Morales): 'DOM change OK but need to coordinate with table virtualization; ensure focusable item index maps to virtualized row id.'
2026-03-09 (Sana Ahmed): 'Arabic strings expand more than expected in rollout modal — add max-height scroll with preserved focus for keyboard users.'
Design updates made 2026-03-10 addressing these points; awaiting sign-off from Accessibility and Localization leads.
next_steps: 1) Finalize Figma annotations and upload annotated screenshots to Confluence (owner: Maya). 2) Create two frontend PRs: a) semantic button conversions for rollout timeline; b) focus token + dark theme color updates (owner: Diego). 3) Add e2e keyboard test cases in Cypress for the 4 primary flows (owner: Luca). 4) Coordinate with Localization team to provide sample translated strings and test RTL build (owner: Sana).
notes_short: In-review design sweep covering keyboard nav, contrast, and i18n readiness for dashboards, rollouts, and cost-view. Prototype and spec in artifacts; PRs pending.
